title: STORY-001-AC-7 duplicates STORY-001-AC-3
detail: Both criteria express the same check (min-exclusive:customerCount:{"threshold":0}).
recommendation: Merge REQ-008 (STORY-001-AC-7) into REQ-004 (STORY-001-AC-3) so the rule is tested once and traced to one criterion.

evidence.quote: The customer count must be greater than zero.
The number of customers must be at least one.

title: EPIC-10-AC-1 allows 12 customers; data dictionary and code allow 10
detail: EPIC-10-AC-1 says up to 12; Reservation.customerCount has max 10 and force-app/main/default/classes/ReservationValidator.cls:61 rejects values above 10.
recommendation: Confirm the maximum with the product owner. Until then treat 10 as the tested upper bound and record EPIC-10-AC-1 as needing clarification.

evidence.quote: A reservation may include up to 12 customers.

proposedAction.note: Tested upper bound is 10 (dictionary and code); 12 pending product-owner confirmation.

title: BR-007 has no acceptance criterion in STORY-001
detail: The business-rules catalogue requires "The requested resource must be available for the selected dates." but no STORY-001 acceptance criterion states it.
recommendation: Add an acceptance criterion to STORY-001: "The requested resource must be available for the selected dates."

evidence.quote: The requested resource must be available for the selected dates.

proposedAction.text: The requested resource must be available for the selected dates.

title: Code enforces INVALID_EMAIL (BR-D01) but no requirement states it
detail: force-app/main/default/classes/ReservationValidator.cls:47 rejects requests with INVALID_EMAIL. Neither STORY-001 nor the rules catalogue mention it.
recommendation: Confirm the behavior and, if intended, add it to the rules catalogue as "Customer email must be valid." so it is tested and traced.

title: Code enforces PAYMENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED (BR-D02) but no requirement states it
detail: force-app/main/default/classes/ReservationValidator.cls:82 rejects requests with PAYMENT_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Neither STORY-001 nor the rules catalogue mention it.
recommendation: Confirm the behavior and, if intended, add it to the rules catalogue as "Payment must be authorized by the payment gateway." so it is tested and traced.

proposedAction.text: Payment must be authorized by the payment gateway.
